module: Node "Is Coupled" (category `repeat_instant`, tags event/attach/detach). Tests whether two vehicles are coupled (`mgr.modules.vehicle:isCoupledTo(vehA, vehB)`). Input pins: `vehA`, `vehB`. Outputs: flow `coupled`, flow `decoupled`, bool `isCoupled`.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Fills `coupled`, `decoupled` and `isCoupled` from the result of `isCoupledTo`. Parameter `args` unused.
